messages.content: cek apakah stok untuk ukuran L dan M sudah di bawah ambang minimum dan perlu diisi kembali?

function.name: inventory_restock_check
function.description: Checks the inventory levels for specified items and determines if restocking is required based on minimum threshold levels. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_ids.description: A list of unique integer identifiers for items to check in the inventory.

threshold.description: The minimum inventory level before restocking is triggered.

include_discontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued items in the restock check.

message.content: Untuk memeriksa tingkat persediaan secara akurat, saya butuh ID unik dari barang yang dimaksud (misalnya kode SKU atau nomor internal). Apakah Anda dapat memberikan daftar ID barang yang berhubungan dengan ukuran L dan M? Jika tidak ada ID spesifik, beri tahu produk atau kategori apa yang ingin Anda cek, sehingga saya bisa menyesuaikan permintaan ke sistem inventaris.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "cek apakah stok untuk ukuran L dan M sudah di bawah ambang minimum dan perlu diisi kembali?" They want to check inventory for sizes L and M. We need item IDs for those sizes. But we don't have them. We can ask clarifying question: which product or item IDs correspond to sizes L and M? Or maybe they refer to specific items known to us. Since we don't know, we should ask for clarification.
